description: Issue #148 (ADR scope-derivation section 6, L4): a worker whose scope gate names the SAME violating paths twice in a row is not sent a third message. The re-instruction is already correct — it transcribes the paths and says the fix lives in the Issue — so re-sending it spends the rest of --max-turns 5 collecting the same answer (measured: Kewton/BorderFreeKidsMap #35 burned a whole run this way). The stop is measured in SENDS (2, not 5), not in status; it rides the existing verification-failure adjudication (no new stop_reason) and names itself with blocking_reasons[].code = scope_unsatisfiable, whose detail carries the violating paths an operator has to add to the Issue.

blocking_details_include: the fix is in the Issue, not in the worktree
summary_includes: Issue の対象ファイルに足して re-plan する
summary_excludes: verification 失敗の worktree を診断し
